_comment: Move pool. category: physical (Atk vs Def) / special (SpA vs SpD) / status (no damage). pp = max Power Points. priority: higher acts first regardless of Speed (default 0). effect may combine: { status, volatile ('confusion'|'flinch'), stages {stat:delta}, target ('self'|'foe'), chance (default 100) }. Self-targeted stage moves never miss.

nudge.name: Nudge
nudge.flavor: A light shove with the whole body.

quick_jab.name: Quick Jab
quick_jab.flavor: A blindingly fast poke that always strikes first.

headbutt.name: Headbutt
headbutt.flavor: A blunt charge that may make the foe flinch.

guard_break.name: Guard Break
guard_break.flavor: A shoulder-first shove that ignores footing.

body_slam.name: Body Slam
body_slam.flavor: Throws full weight into the target; may paralyze.

rattle_cry.name: Rattle Cry
rattle_cry.flavor: A rattling cry that saps the foe's Attack.

brace_up.name: Brace Up
brace_up.flavor: Plants the feet and braces, raising Defense.

gale_step.name: Gale Step
gale_step.flavor: A burst of footwork that sharply raises Speed.

ember_jab.name: Ember Jab
ember_jab.flavor: Pokes with a fingertip of flame.

flame_burst.name: Flame Burst
flame_burst.flavor: A short bloom of fire; may burn.

cinder_storm.name: Cinder Storm
cinder_storm.flavor: A swirl of hot embers; may burn.

singe.name: Singe
singe.flavor: Sears the target with a wisp of flame, burning it.

water_pulse.name: Water Pulse
water_pulse.flavor: A rippling ring of force; may confuse.

spark_nip.name: Spark Nip
spark_nip.flavor: A nip carrying a static charge.

volt_arc.name: Volt Arc
volt_arc.flavor: A jumping arc of current; may paralyze.

thunder_slam.name: Thunder Slam
thunder_slam.flavor: A charged, full-body slam; may paralyze.

static_field.name: Static Field
static_field.flavor: Blankets the target in static, paralyzing it.

venom_jab.name: Venom Jab
venom_jab.flavor: A toxic-tipped jab that may poison.

toxic_spray.name: Toxic Spray
toxic_spray.flavor: Douses the target in worsening venom (badly poisons).

frost_breath.name: Frost Breath
frost_breath.flavor: An icy exhale that may freeze.

mud_shot.name: Mud Shot
mud_shot.flavor: Hurls a wad of heavy mud.
